## One cached revision query per run. Stamping frames never launches a process.
## Python and Godot share tools/picture_font.json and the same sidecar schema.
const BUILD_INFO := "res://build_info.json"
const BUILD_FONT := "res://tools/picture_font.json"
static var _contexts: Dictionary = {}
static var _glyphs: Dictionary = {}

static func save_png(image: Image, path: String, stage: String = "installed in game") -> Error:
	return _save(image, path, stage, false, 0.9)

static func save_jpg(image: Image, path: String, quality: float = 0.9, stage: String = "installed in game") -> Error:
	return _save(image, path, stage, true, quality)

static func _hash(bytes: PackedByteArray) -> String:
	var hash := HashingContext.new()
	hash.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
	hash.update(bytes)
	return hash.finish().hex_encode()

static func _context() -> Dictionary:
	var repo := ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://").path_join("..")
	if not OS.has_feature("editor"):
		# Only an export in a checkout can use the legacy Git path without packed metadata.
		var git_marker := repo.path_join(".git")
		var in_checkout := FileAccess.file_exists(git_marker) or DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(git_marker)
		if FileAccess.file_exists(BUILD_INFO) or not in_checkout:
			return _build_context()
	var repo_override := OS.get_environment("PICTURE_SOURCE_REPO")
	if not repo_override.is_empty():
		repo = repo_override
	if _contexts.has(repo):
		return _contexts[repo]
	var record := _checkout_context(repo)
	if record.is_empty():
		return _build_context()
	_contexts[repo] = record
	return record

static func _read_json(path: String) -> Dictionary:
	var file := FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return {}
	var json := JSON.new()
	if json.parse(file.get_as_text()) != OK or not json.data is Dictionary:
		return {}
	return json.data

static func _build_context() -> Dictionary:
	if _contexts.has(BUILD_INFO):
		return _contexts[BUILD_INFO]
	var info := _read_json(BUILD_INFO)
	var commit: Variant = info.get("commit")
	var date: Variant = info.get("commit_date")
	var full_commit := RegEx.create_from_string("\\A(?!0+\\z)(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})\\z")
	if not commit is String or not full_commit.search(commit) or not date is String or not _is_utc_date(date):
		push_error("Picture provenance unavailable: no Git checkout context or valid " + BUILD_INFO + " with a full commit and UTC commit date")
		return {}
	var glyphs := _read_json(BUILD_FONT)
	if not glyphs.has("?"):
		push_error("Picture provenance build font missing or invalid: " + BUILD_FONT)
		return {}
	_glyphs = glyphs
	var record := {"source_commit": commit, "source_commit_date": date, "source_dirty": false, "source_diff_sha256": ""}
	_contexts[BUILD_INFO] = record
	return record

static func _is_utc_date(date: String) -> bool:
	var utc_date := RegEx.create_from_string("\\A[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z\\z")
	if not utc_date.search(date):
		return false
	var seconds := Time.get_unix_time_from_datetime_string(date.trim_suffix("Z"))
	return Time.get_datetime_string_from_unix_time(seconds) + "Z" == date

static func _checkout_context(repo: String) -> Dictionary:
	var helper := OS.get_environment("PICTURE_STAMP_TOOL")
	if helper.is_empty():
		helper = repo.path_join("tools/picture_provenance.py")
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(helper):
		return {}
	var glyphs := _read_json(helper.get_base_dir().path_join("picture_font.json"))
	if not glyphs.has("?"):
		return {}
	var python := OS.get_environment("PICTURE_PYTHON")
	if python.is_empty():
		var pc := OS.get_environment("USERPROFILE").path_join("Downloads")
		for candidate in [pc.path_join("ComfyUI_windows_portable/python_embeded/python.exe"), pc.path_join("voidsworn_test/blender/blender-4.5.14-windows-x64/4.5/python/bin/python.exe")]:
			if FileAccess.file_exists(candidate):
				python = candidate
				break
	if python.is_empty():
		python = "python" if OS.get_name() == "Windows" else "python3"
	var output: Array = []
	var code := OS.execute(python, PackedStringArray([helper, "context", "--repo", repo]), output, true)
	if code != 0 or output.is_empty():
		push_error("Picture provenance context FAILED: " + str(output))
		return {}
	var record: Variant = JSON.parse_string(str(output[0]))
	if not record is Dictionary or not record.has("source_commit"):
		return {}
	_glyphs = glyphs
	return record

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 516), '#11151e')
+        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+        for x, label, image in [(12, 'Main / JPEG', left), (646, 'Branch / PNG', right)]:
+            draw.text((x, 15), f'C19_51  |  {title}  |  {label}', fill='#f1e8d9', font_size=19)
+            image.thumbnail((622, 350), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+            canvas.paste(image, (x + (622 - image.width) // 2, 44))
+        path = output / f'C19_51_game_{name.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]}.png'
+        review.save(canvas, path, optimize=True)
+        verify(path)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('main', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('branch', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    compare(args.main, args.branch, args.output)

'use strict';
// Node 18+, no dependencies. All child processes run from the repository root.
//
// Issue 358: the table tells the truth. A row has one of four words:
//   PASS  the check found zero failures inside the row
//   KNOWN only failures that sit on the baseline list, with the count
//   FAIL  anything else
//   SKIP  the check could not run on this machine (optional dependency)
// A PASS row never carries a failure count, a CHECK count or a differed count.
// A listed id that passes (or no longer runs) is an error until it is taken
// off the list. The pack CHECK count and the drift differed count are held
// against ceilings in checks_baseline.json that can only go down.
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');

// Issue 357: the rules math targets V8 in Node 22; another major gives a false parity failure.
if (require.main === module && process.versions.node.split('.')[0] !== '22') {
  console.error('FAIL: Node major 22 is required, found ' + process.versions.node + '. Use the bundled Node 22 at voidsworn_test/node/node.exe.');
  process.exit(1);
}

function readBaseline() {
  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'checks_baseline.json'), 'utf8'));
}

const ascii = s => String(s).replace(/[^\x20-\x7e\n\r\t]/g, '?');

// ---------- result-word rules (issue 358) ----------

function verdictLine(output) {
  const lines = String(output || '').split(/\r?\n/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (/^(PASS|FAIL)\b/.test(lines[i])) return lines[i];
  return '';
}

function parseFindings(output) {
  const passIds = [], failIds = [];
  let summary = null;
  for (const raw of String(output || '').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const line = raw.trim();
    let m = /^PASS\s+(\S+)(?:\s|$)/.exec(line);
    if (m) { passIds.push(m[1]); continue; }
    m = /^FAIL\s+(\S+)(?:\s|$)/.exec(line);
    if (m) { failIds.push(m[1]); continue; }
    m = /^(\d+)\s+tests,\s+(\d+)\s+pass,\s+(\d+)\s+fail/.exec(line);
    if (m) summary = { total: +m[1], pass: +m[2], fail: +m[3] };
  }
  return { passIds, failIds, summary };
}

function classifyFindings(run, baseline) {
  const { passIds, failIds, summary } = parseFindings(run.output);
  if (!summary) return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: missing findings summary' };
  if (passIds.length !== summary.pass || failIds.length !== summary.fail) {
    return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: parsed ' + passIds.length + ' pass / ' + failIds.length + ' fail lines, summary says ' + summary.pass + ' / ' + summary.fail };
  }
  const listed = new Set(baseline.knownFindingsFailures || []);
  const known = failIds.filter(id => listed.has(id));
  const unexpected = failIds.filter(id => !listed.has(id));
  const listedPasses = passIds.filter(id => listed.has(id));
  const seen = new Set([...passIds, ...failIds]);
  const listedMissing = [...listed].filter(id => !seen.has(id));
  if (listedPasses.length) return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: listed id(s) now pass, take them off the list: ' + listedPasses.join(', ') };
  if (unexpected.length) return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: ' + unexpected.length + ' new failure(s): ' + unexpected.join(', ') };
  if (listedMissing.length) return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: listed id(s) no longer run: ' + listedMissing.join(', ') };
  if (known.length) return { result: 'KNOWN', detail: 'KNOWN: ' + known.length + ' listed failure(s): ' + known.join(', ') };
  return { result: 'PASS', detail: 'PASS: all ' + summary.total + ' gated findings tests pass' };
}

function classifyPack(run, baseline) {
  const out = String(run.output || '');
  const m = /SUMMARY:\s*(\d+)\s+FAIL,\s*(\d+)\s+CHECK/.exec(out);
  if (!m) return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: missing check pack summary' };
  const fails = +m[1], checks = +m[2];
  const failLines = (out.match(/^FAIL\b/gm) || []).length;
  const ceiling = Number.isFinite(baseline.checksCeiling) ? baseline.checksCeiling : 0;
  if (run.code !== 0 || fails > 0 || failLines > 0) {
    return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: ' + fails + ' FAIL, ' + checks + ' CHECK' + (run.code !== 0 ? ' (exit ' + run.code + ')' : '') };
  }
  if (checks > ceiling) {
    return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: ' + checks + ' CHECK is above the baseline ceiling of ' + ceiling };
  }
  return { result: 'PASS', detail: 'PASS: within the pack baseline' };
}

function classifyDrift(run, baseline) {
  const out = String(run.output || '');
  let m = /DRIFT SUMMARY:[^\n]*?(\d+)\s+differed/.exec(out);
  if (!m) m = /constants:\s*\d+\s+entries compared,\s*\d+\s+matched,\s*(\d+)\s+differed/.exec(out);
  if (!m) return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: missing drift summary' };
  const differed = +m[1];
  const ceiling = Number.isFinite(baseline.driftDifferedCeiling) ? baseline.driftDifferedCeiling : 0;
  if (differed > ceiling) return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: ' + differed + ' differed is above the baseline ceiling of ' + ceiling };
  if (differed > 0) return { result: 'KNOWN', detail: 'KNOWN: ' + differed + ' constant difference(s) within the baseline' };
  return { result: 'PASS', detail: 'PASS: no constant drift' };
}

function classifyNaming(run, baseline) {
  const m = /naming_lint_game: (\d+) hard, (\d+) word/.exec(String(run.output || ''));
  if (!m) return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: missing naming summary' };
  const hard = +m[1], word = +m[2];
  const ceiling = Number.isFinite(baseline.namingHardHits) ? baseline.namingHardHits : 0;
  if (![0, 1].includes(run.code) || hard > ceiling) {
    return { result: 'FAIL', detail: 'FAIL: ' + hard + ' hard hits above the baseline of ' + ceiling + ', ' + word + ' word hits' };
  }
  return { result: 'PASS', detail: 'PASS: naming lint within the baseline' };
}

function Run-Godot([string]"'$Name,[string]$Path,[string[]]$ArgsList,[int]$Limit=300) {
    $profile=Join-Path $work ".onboarding_checks'"\\"'$Name"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $profile | Out-Null
    $env:APPDATA=$profile
    $base=Join-Path $logs $Name
    $arguments=@('"'--headless','--path',('\"' + "'$Path + '"'\"')) + "'$ArgsList
    $p=Start-Process -FilePath $Godot -ArgumentList $arguments -RedirectStandardOutput "$base.out" -RedirectStandardError "$base.err" -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
    $null=$p.Handle
    if(!$p.WaitForExit($Limit*1000)){
        $p.Kill()
        Write-Output "$Name FAIL timed out"
        return
    }
    $p.WaitForExit()
    $scriptErrors=Select-String "$base.out","$base.err" -Pattern '"'SCRIPT ERROR'
    if("'$p.ExitCode -or $scriptErrors){
        Write-Output "$Name FAIL exit=$($p.ExitCode)"
        Get-Content "$base.out","$base.err" | Select-Object -Last 15
        return
    }
    Write-Output "$Name PASS"
}

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 516), '#11151e')
+        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+        for x, label, image in [(12, 'Main / JPEG', left), (646, 'Branch / PNG', right)]:
+            draw.text((x, 15), f'C19_51  |  {title}  |  {label}', fill='#f1e8d9', font_size=19)
+            image.thumbnail((622, 350), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+            canvas.paste(image, (x + (622 - image.width) // 2, 44))
+        path = output / f'C19_51_game_{name.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]}.png'
+        review.save(canvas, path, optimize=True)
+        verify(path)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('main', type=Path)

  const at = source.indexOf(old);
  assert(at >= 0 && source.indexOf(old, at + old.length) < 0, `Expected one source match for ${old}`);
  return source.slice(0, at) + value + source.slice(at + old.length);

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 516), '#11151e')
+        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+        for x, label, image in [(12, 'Main / JPEG', left), (646, 'Branch / PNG', right)]:
+            draw.text((x, 15), f'C19_51  |  {title}  |  {label}', fill='#f1e8d9', font_size=19)
+            image.thumbnail((622, 350), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+            canvas.paste(image, (x + (622 - image.width) // 2, 44))
+        path = output / f'C19_51_game_{name.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]}.png'
+        review.save(canvas, path, optimize=True)
+        verify(path)
+
+

func _run() -> void:
	# Every craft kind the factory can draw, not only the faction defaults.
	# Counts 3 and 6 are the arrowhead Ryan asked for (R280); 4 stays covered
	# because setup accepts any count.
	for fac in CRAFT.DEFAULT_KIND:
		for kind in ["fighter", "bomber", "spore"]:
			for count in [3, 4, 6]:
				var wing := make_wing(fac, kind, 3.84, count, 2.731)
				exercise(wing, "%s|%s count %d" % [fac, kind, count])
		if fac != "deathless": # Eclipse has no squadron to park in battle.
			for kind in (["spore"] if fac == "chorus" else ["fighter", "bomber"]):
				exercise_parked(fac, kind)

	for code in ["voidsworn_SF3", "voidsworn_SB4"]:
		var path := sheets.path_join(code + "/checks.json")
		check(FileAccess.file_exists(path), code + ": sheet measurements exist")
		if not FileAccess.file_exists(path): continue
		var sheet: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path))
		var dimensions := Vector3(sheet.model_length, sheet.height_side, maxf(sheet.beam_top, sheet.beam_bow)) / float(sheet.length_from_game)
		var wing := make_wing("voidsworn", "fighter", 3.84, 4, 0.0)
		replace_meshes(wing, dimensions)
		check(is_equal_approx(wing.rests[1].z, 0.95 * wing.length), code + ": original lateral formation retained")
		exercise(wing, code)
	# Mesh-driven regressions: broader than long (KB1CC), long, tall, nested,
	# off-centre and breathing hulls, at different sizes and formation counts.
	for size in [2.0, 3.84, 6.0]:

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 516), '#11151e')

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 516), '#11151e')
+        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+        for x, label, image in [(12, 'Main / JPEG', left), (646, 'Branch / PNG', right)]:
+            draw.text((x, 15), f'C19_51  |  {title}  |  {label}', fill='#f1e8d9', font_size=19)
+            image.thumbnail((622, 350), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+            canvas.paste(image, (x + (622 - image.width) // 2, 44))
+        path = output / f'C19_51_game_{name.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]}.png'
+        review.save(canvas, path, optimize=True)
+        verify(path)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('main', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('branch', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    compare(args.main, args.branch, args.output)

static func _save(image: Image, path: String, stage: String, jpeg: bool, quality: float) -> Error:
	var context := _context()
	if context.is_empty() or _glyphs.is_empty() or stage not in ["sheet built", "paint proof", "installed in game"]:
		return _failed(path)
	var absolute := ProjectSettings.globalize_path(path)
	var source := context.duplicate()
	source.stage = stage
	var record := context.duplicate()
	record.merge({"schema": 1, "picture_name": absolute.get_file(), "stage": stage,
		"date": Time.get_datetime_string_from_system(true) + "Z", "sources": [source], "inputs": []})
	var original := image.duplicate() as Image
	original.convert(Image.FORMAT_RGB8 if jpeg else Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	var strip := _strip(record, original.get_size())
	if strip == null:
		return _failed(path)
	var box := Rect2i(0, original.get_height() - strip.get_height(), strip.get_width(), strip.get_height())
	var covered := original.get_region(box).save_png_to_buffer()
	record.stamp_template_sha256 = _hash(strip.get_data())
	strip.convert(original.get_format())
	original.blit_rect(strip, Rect2i(Vector2i.ZERO, strip.get_size()), box.position)
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(absolute.get_base_dir())
	var result := original.save_jpg(absolute, quality) if jpeg else original.save_png(absolute)
	if result != OK:
		return result
	var saved := Image.load_from_file(absolute)
	saved.convert(Image.FORMAT_RGB8)
	record.merge({"stamp_box": [box.position.x, box.position.y, box.end.x, box.end.y],
		"strip_size": [strip.get_width(), strip.get_height()],
		"covered_pixels": [Marshalls.raw_to_base64(covered)],
		"strip_sha256": [_hash(saved.get_region(box).get_data())],
		"image_sha256": _hash(FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(absolute))})
	var manifest := FileAccess.open(absolute + ".provenance.json", FileAccess.WRITE)
	if manifest == null:
		return _failed(path)
	manifest.store_string(JSON.stringify(record, "\t") + "\n")
	return OK

// Wait for a claim until waitSeconds pass. Resolves with the holder once it is written; throws "admission timed out" or
// "admission cancelled" (owner exited, or cancelled() turned true) and then releases anything it reserved. tx and clock are
// for tests: tx defaults to the localhost lock, clock to the real one.
async function admit(slots, holder, { waitSeconds, cancelled = () => false, onWait = () => {}, waiterPid = process.pid,
  clock = realClock, tx = transaction } = {}) {
  const deadline = clock.now() + waitSeconds * 1000;
  let handedOff = false, touched = false;
  const check = () => {
    if (cancelled() || !slots.isAlive(holder.pid)) throw new Error('GPU admission cancelled');
    if (clock.now() >= deadline) throw new Error(`GPU admission timed out after ${waitSeconds} seconds`);
  };
  let heartbeat = clock.now();
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const claim = await tx(() => { touched = true; return slots.step(holder, waiterPid); }, check, deadline, clock);
      check();
      if (claim) { handedOff = true; return claim; }
      if (clock.now() - heartbeat >= 60000) { onWait(); heartbeat = clock.now(); }
      await clock.sleep(Math.min(250, Math.max(0, deadline - clock.now())));
    }
  } finally {
    try {
      if (!handedOff && touched) await tx(() => slots.release(holder.token), undefined, undefined, clock);
    } catch (e) { console.error('GPU claim cleanup: ' + e.message); }
  }
}
if (require.main === module) main().catch(e => { console.error('GPU claim: ' + e.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
module.exports = { Slots, modeFor, weightFor, transaction, codeOnlyLane, admit, MAX_WAIT_SECONDS };

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 516), '#11151e')

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 516), '#11151e')
+        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+        for x, label, image in [(12, 'Main / JPEG', left), (646, 'Branch / PNG', right)]:
+            draw.text((x, 15), f'C19_51  |  {title}  |  {label}', fill='#f1e8d9', font_size=19)
+            image.thumbnail((622, 350), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+            canvas.paste(image, (x + (622 - image.width) // 2, 44))
+        path = output / f'C19_51_game_{name.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]}.png'
+        review.save(canvas, path, optimize=True)
+        verify(path)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('main', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('branch', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    compare(args.main, args.branch, args.output)

# Ship recipe: the standing checks every ship keeps for the rest of its life (outside audit pass 2, findings 3, 4 and 13;
# FINDINGS R160 point (f); docs/ship_pipeline/HARDPOINTS.md). Plain Python, no bpy and no numpy.
#   outline  the outline score per third (bow, midship, stern) and the inner edge check from the concept camera. The
#            overlap numbers are REPORTED against the ship json outline_gate, never a pass bar (RULEBOOK 5.8); missing
#            numbers or missing inner edge distances still fail loudly.
#   battle   the outline score from the second camera, the game's battle camera at r 170 (outline_battle.py), both cameras
#   paint    the concept side, the far side and the underside stills all exist (stage 5 render.py)
#   blink    the concept and model blink sheet exists (blink.py)
#   licences every downloaded texture used by the bake has its licence line recorded per texture as used
#   lights   every window and trim light is at least light_min_px across at the battle camera on a 70 px ship
#   all      every check above; the recipe runs this before stage 7 will export
#   selftest build good fixtures in the system temp folder and prove each check refuses its own broken copy
# usage: python standing.py CHECK --ship SHIP.json --job JOB_DIR
#   The stage outputs are read from JOB_DIR: sil/outline_thirds.json, sil/outline_battle.json, r/<cell>_*.png, bow_blink.gif,
#   textures/ and licences.json. Nothing is written outside the system temp folder by selftest.
import os, sys, json, shutil, tempfile, argparse

THIRDS = ('bow', 'midship', 'stern')
LICENCES = ('CC0', 'CC-BY', 'CC-BY-SA', 'public domain', 'own work', 'own')
EDGE_KEYS = ('edge_cell_to_concept_median_px', 'edge_cell_within_6px', 'edge_concept_to_cell_median_px', 'edge_concept_within_6px')


def load_ship(path):
    with open(path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        return json.load(f)


def fail(msg):
    print('FAIL', msg)
    return 1


def ok(msg):
    print('PASS', msg)
    return 0


def check_outline(ship, job):
    cell = ship.get('cell') or ship.get('ship')
    gate = 100.0 * float(ship.get('outline_gate', .9))
    slack = float(ship.get('outline_third_slack', 5.0))
    floor = gate - slack
    p = os.path.join(job, 'sil', 'outline_thirds.json')
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return fail(f'outline: no {p} (stage 3 and stage 4 must run outline_thirds.py)')
    d = json.load(open(p, encoding='utf-8')).get('cells', {}).get(cell)
    if not d:
        return fail(f'outline: no cell {cell} in {p}')
    bad = []
    for t in THIRDS:
        n = d.get(t) or {}
        if 'overlap' not in n:
            bad.append(f'{t}: no overlap'); continue
        for k in EDGE_KEYS:
            if k not in n:
                bad.append(f'{t}: no {k} (the inner edge check did not run)')
    whole = (d.get('whole') or {}).get('overlap')
    if whole is None:
        bad.append('no whole overlap')
    if bad:
        for b in bad:
            print('  FAIL', b)
        return fail(f'outline: {cell} does not have a complete standing outline record')
    # RULEBOOK 5.8: the overlap against the concept is a reported number, not a pass bar. The old gate and floor are
    # printed beside it so the builder can see where the shape sits, and a low number is a note, never a failure.
    print(f'  outline {cell}: bow {d["bow"]["overlap"]}, midship {d["midship"]["overlap"]}, stern {d["stern"]["overlap"]}, whole {whole} '
          f'(reported, not a pass bar; old gate {gate:.0f}, old per-third floor {floor:.1f})')
    print(f'  inner edges within 6 px bow {d["bow"]["edge_cell_within_6px"]}, midship {d["midship"]["edge_cell_within_6px"]}, stern {d["stern"]["edge_cell_within_6px"]}')
    for t in THIRDS:
        v = float(d[t]['overlap'])
        if v < floor:
            print(f'  REPORT {t} overlap {v} percent is below the old per-third floor {floor:.1f}; no failure (RULEBOOK 5.8)')
    if float(whole) < gate:
        print(f'  REPORT whole overlap {whole} percent is below the old gate {gate:.0f}; no failure (RULEBOOK 5.8)')
    return ok('outline per third and inner edge data are present; the overlap is reported, not a pass bar')


def check_battle(ship, job):
    cell = ship.get('cell') or ship.get('ship')
    p = os.path.join(job, 'sil', 'outline_battle.json')
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return fail(f'battle camera: no {p} (stage 4 must run outline_battle.py)')
    d = json.load(open(p, encoding='utf-8')).get('cells', {}).get(cell)
    if not d:
        return fail(f'battle camera: no cell {cell} in {p}')
    bad = []
    for cam in ('game', 'studio'):
        n = d.get(cam) or {}
        for t in THIRDS + ('whole',):
            if t not in n:
                bad.append(f'{cam} {t}: missing')
    if bad:
        for b in bad:
            print('  FAIL', b)
        return fail(f'battle camera: {cell} has no complete second-camera score')
    print('  battle camera ' + cell + ': ' + ', '.join(f'{cam} ' + ' '.join(f'{t} {d[cam][t]}' for t in THIRDS + ('whole',)) for cam in ('game', 'studio')))
    return ok('the outline score from the second camera (the game battle camera, r 170) is recorded')


def check_paint(ship, job):
    cell = ship.get('cell') or ship.get('ship')
    need = {
        'concept side': os.path.join(job, 'r', f'{cell}_concept_cl.png'),
        'far side': os.path.join(job, 'r', f'{cell}_side_s.png'),
        'underside': os.path.join(job, 'r', f'{cell}_below.png'),
    }
    missing = [f'{k}: {v}' for k, v in need.items() if not os.path.exists(v)]
    if missing:
        for m in missing:
            print('  FAIL', m)
        return fail('paint: the concept side, far side and underside stills must all be rendered')
    return ok('paint is judged on the concept side, the far side and the underside stills')


def check_blink(ship, job):
    p = os.path.join(job, 'bow_blink.gif')
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return fail(f'blink: no {p} (stage 5 must run blink.py)')
    return ok('the concept and model blink sheet exists')


def check_licences(ship, job):
    tdir = os.path.join(job, 'textures')
    files = []
    if os.path.isdir(tdir):
        for root, _, names in os.walk(tdir):
            for n in names:
                files.append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, n), tdir).replace('\\', '/'))
    if not files:
        return ok('licences: no downloaded textures are used (nothing to record)')
    p = os.path.join(job, 'licences.json')
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return fail(f'licences: {len(files)} downloaded textures but no {p}')
    try:
        rows = json.load(open(p, encoding='utf-8')).get('textures', [])
    except ValueError as e:
        return fail(f'licences: {p} is not JSON: {e}')
    by_file = {}
    for r in rows:
        if not isinstance(r, dict) or not r.get('file'):
            return fail(f'licences: an entry has no file: {r!r}')
        by_file[str(r['file']).replace('\\', '/')] = r
    bad = []
    for f in files:
        r = by_file.get(f)
        if r is None:
            bad.append(f'{f}: no licence line'); continue
        for k in ('source', 'licence', 'used'):
            if not r.get(k):
                bad.append(f'{f}: no {k}')
        if r.get('licence') and str(r['licence']) not in LICENCES:
            bad.append(f'{f}: licence {r["licence"]!r} is not one of {", ".join(LICENCES)}')
    if bad:
        for b in bad:
            print('  FAIL', b)
        return fail(f'licences: {len(bad)} problem(s); every downloaded texture needs its own line as used')
    return ok(f'licences: {len(files)} downloaded texture(s), each with a source, a licence and what it is used for')


def _px(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return v.get('px')
    return v


def check_lights(ship, job):
    lights = dict(ship.get('lights') or {})
    # issue 601: a paint stack that builds lights measures them and writes the job's lights.json; the measured size wins
    mp = os.path.join(job, 'lights.json')
    if os.path.exists(mp):
        try:
            lights.update(json.load(open(mp, encoding='utf-8')).get('lights', {}))
        except ValueError as e:
            return fail(f'lights: {mp} is not JSON: {e}')
    if not lights:
        return ok('lights: no window or trim lights are declared (the paint has no light map yet)')
    floor = float(ship.get('light_min_px', 2.0))
    bad = []
    points = []
    for k, v in lights.items():
        if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get('point'):      # R228 item 4: a point light reads by its brightness; its size is reported
            points.append(f'{k} {v.get("count", "?")} at {v.get("px")} px'); continue
        px = _px(v)
        if px is None:
            bad.append(f'{k}: no px size'); continue
        if float(px) < floor:
            bad.append(f'{k}: {px} px across on a 70 px ship is below the {floor:.1f} px floor')
    if bad:
        for b in bad:
            print('  FAIL', b)
        return fail('lights: a light that is too small will not read at the battle camera')
    pt = f'; point lights (R228, read by brightness, not held to the size floor): {", ".join(points)}' if points else ''
    return ok(f'lights: every declared window and trim light is at least {floor:.1f} px across on a 70 px ship{pt}')


CHECKS = dict(outline=check_outline, battle=check_battle, paint=check_paint, blink=check_blink, licences=check_licences, lights=check_lights)


def run(name, ship, job):
    return CHECKS[name](ship, job)


def write_fixture(root, good=True):
    """the good fixture, or one broken copy per check when good is False. Returns (ship json path, job dir)."""
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, 'sil'), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, 'r'), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, 'textures'), exist_ok=True)
    ship = dict(ship='SELFTEST', cell='T1', outline_gate=.9, outline_third_slack=5.0, lights={'window_px': 2.5, 'trim_px': 2.0}, light_min_px=2.0)
    if not good:
        ship['lights']['trim_px'] = 1.0
    sp = os.path.join(root, 'ship.json')
    json.dump(ship, open(sp, 'w'), indent=1)
    thirds = {}
    for k, v in (('bow', 80.0), ('midship', 80.0), ('stern', 70.0)):
        thirds[k] = dict(overlap=v, **{e: 10.0 for e in EDGE_KEYS})

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 524), '#11151e')
+        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+        for x, label, image in [(12, 'Main / JPEG', left), (646, 'Branch / PNG', right)]:
+            draw.text((x, 15), f'C19_51  |  {title}  |  {label}', fill='#f1e8d9', font_size=19)
+            image.thumbnail((622, 350), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+            canvas.paste(image, (x + (622 - image.width) // 2, 44))
+        path = output / f'C19_51_game_{name.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]}.png'
+        review.save(canvas, path, optimize=True)
+        verify(path)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('main', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('branch', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    compare(args.main, args.branch, args.output)

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} captures have different dimensions')
+        mae = sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(left, right)).mean) / 3
+        print(f'{name}: mean absolute RGB difference {mae:.4f}/255')
+
+        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 524), '#11151e')
+        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+        for x, label, image in [(12, 'Main / JPEG', left), (646, 'Branch / PNG', right)]:
+            draw.text((x, 15), f'C19_51  |  {title}  |  {label}', fill='#f1e8d9', font_size=19)
+            image.thumbnail((622, 350), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+            canvas.paste(image, (x + (622 - image.width) // 2, 44))
+        path = output / f'C19_51_game_{name.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]}.png'
+        review.save(canvas, path, optimize=True)
+        verify(path)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('main', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('branch', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    compare(args.main, args.branch, args.output)

+"""Pair the C19_51 battle and close captures from two a4_shots runs."""
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageStat
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
+from picture_provenance import Review, verify
+
+
+VIEWS = {
+    'corsair_battle': 'Battle',
+    'corsair_battle_near': 'Battle zoom',
+    'C19_51_q': 'Bow',
+    'C19_51_s': 'Side',
+    'C19_51_b': 'Below',
+    'C19_51_t': 'Top',
+    'C19_51_d': 'Deck',
+    'C19_51_u': 'Underside',
+}
+
+
+def compare(main, branch, output):
+    for name, title in VIEWS.items():
+        review = Review('installed in game')
+        left, right = [
+            review.open(folder / f'{name}.jpg').convert('RGB')
+            for folder in (main, branch)
+        ]
+        if left.size != right.size:

C19_51 passed stages 4 through 7 on main and the branch. Both exports installed in isolated Godot projects. The battle views look alike, with small differences in grain and highlights up close.

![C19_51 deck comparison](shots/C19_51_game_d.png)

[Battle](shots/C19_51_game_battle.png) · [Battle zoom](shots/C19_51_game_near.png) · [Bow](shots/C19_51_game_q.png) · [Side](shots/C19_51_game_s.png) · [Below](shots/C19_51_game_b.png) · [Top](shots/C19_51_game_t.png) · [Underside](shots/C19_51_game_u.png)

- The installer and nine PC copy jobs now handle PNG maps. The installer test passed with mixed JPEG and PNG maps and rejected stray names.
- PNG encoding took **1.72 s**, below the 10 s threshold for changing compression. Full stage 7 took **151.2 s on main and 160.6 s on the branch**, excluding the solo GPU wait.
- C19_51’s maps grew from **8.10 to 28.42 MiB**. Across nine saved bakes, the average grew from **7.07 to 20.76 MiB**.

The standing suite finished with 75 passes and two recorded baselines. All 85 headless Godot checks, the bot battle, and the rebaked A16 seam check passed. The A16 model was byte-identical after rebaking, so only its record changed.

The [README](contrib/codex/pipeline_1119/README.md) records the timing estimates for the original GPU waits, the measured retests, and the files changed. Nothing was committed.
